referral.q: Do I need a referral to schedule a visit?
referral.a: No referral is required for most orthopedic consultations. We coordinate directly with your primary care physician when relevant.

insurance.q: Which insurance plans do you accept?
insurance.a: We accept most major insurers in Utah — including Medicare, SelectHealth, Blue Cross, Aetna and United Healthcare. Contact us to verify your specific plan.

wait.q: How soon can I be seen?
wait.a: Most patients are scheduled within 5 to 10 business days. Urgent cases — including post-injury — are seen within 48 hours when possible.

imaging.a: Yes. Our clinic includes in-house MRI and digital X-ray so most patients leave their first visit with a complete diagnosis.

about.title: Care that meets you where you are.
about.intro: Orthopedic PI was built on a single conviction: that recovery happens fastest when patients are partners — not passengers. We combine fellowship-trained specialists, on-site imaging and in-house physical therapy under one roof so your care moves at your pace, not the system's.
about.valuesTitle: What guides every decision we make.

humanity.title: Humanity

about.techTitle: Tools as advanced as the medicine.
about.techDescription: On-site 3-Tesla MRI, digital X-ray, robotic-assisted joint replacement and minimally invasive arthroscopy — the same technology used at top academic centers, available in your community.

firstVisit.title: Your first visit
firstVisit.description: Plan on 45 to 60 minutes. We'll review your history, examine the affected area, and — when needed — order on-site imaging so you leave with a clear plan.
items: List of current medications and supplements
Any prior imaging on a disc or by patient portal
Wear comfortable clothing that allows access to the affected area

insurance.title: Insurance & costs
insurance.description: We accept Medicare, SelectHealth, Blue Cross, Aetna, United Healthcare and most major plans. Our billing team will verify your coverage before your visit and provide a written estimate for any out-of-pocket cost.

preop.title: Pre-op instructions
preop.description: If surgery is recommended, you'll receive personalized pre-op instructions at least two weeks in advance — including medication adjustments, fasting guidance, and what to bring on the day of surgery.

postop.title: Post-op care
postop.description: Recovery is structured, supported, and stays with one team. Most patients begin gentle movement within 24 hours of surgery and meet with their physical therapist within the first week.

parking.label: Parking & accessibility
parking.description: Free patient parking on-site. Accessible spaces and ramp access at the main entrance. Public transit accessible via UTA bus routes 220 and 223.
